question: Are the GitHub Pages project sites linked from in-scope pages part of this migration?
context: Articles link 4 same-host project sites (/ai-sandbox/, /bruce-hackathon-2026-09-12/, /bruce-lava-dash/, /bruce-play-ten/); 3 more (/adapt-to-2026-demo/, /denison-2026-04-24/, /harness-v2-test/) share the host unlinked. The brief keeps all 7 on GitHub Pages under Cloudflare.
options: No: they stay on GitHub Pages, routed by Cloudflare
Yes: migrate them too
default_assumption: No: they stay on GitHub Pages; Cloudflare routes their prefixes away from EDS.
effective: No: they stay on GitHub Pages; Cloudflare routes their prefixes away from EDS.

question: Is the EDS URL format accepted, with redirects for every changed path?
context: Every page is a folder URL with a trailing slash today. EDS serves /writing/<slug> unless each page is authored as an index document; external links and search results point at the slash form.
options: Author every page as <path>/index so the slash URLs stay
Drop the trailing slash and redirect each old URL
Mix: keep slash for hubs, drop for articles
default_assumption: Author every page as <path>/index so the slash URLs stay and no redirect is needed.
effective: Author every page as <path>/index so the slash URLs stay and no redirect is needed.

question: Do the EDS hosts use the same GA4 property (G-ZVENE6BXTJ)?
context: One gtag property on 34/34 pages, loaded async today. EDS loads it in the delayed phase to keep Lighthouse 100.
options: Same property, delayed load
New property for EDS
default_assumption: Same property, delayed load; .aem.page and .aem.live hosts filtered in GA.
effective: Same property, delayed load; .aem.page and .aem.live hosts filtered in GA.

question: Should the migration add a consent banner or Google Consent Mode?
context: No CMP and no consent defaults today; gtag and the Cloudflare beacon load unconditionally.
options: Keep as today (no banner)
Add Consent Mode defaults (denied until choice)
Add a CMP
default_assumption: Keep as today; the replica changes nothing the visitor sees.
effective: Keep as today; the replica changes nothing the visitor sees.

question: Where do the images live after cutover?
context: Every image is a file in the GitHub Pages repo (article images/, portfolio/assets/, /assets/) and the project sites keep serving from GitHub Pages. Badges are hotlinked from Credly and Microsoft.
options: Upload all images to DA (EDS media bus)
Keep them on GitHub Pages and link absolute URLs
DA for page images, hotlinks kept for badges
default_assumption: Upload page images to DA so EDS optimizes them; keep badge hotlinks until a later pass.
effective: Upload page images to DA so EDS optimizes them; keep badge hotlinks until a later pass.

question: Is the client-side writing filter over the query index enough, or is full-text search required?
context: Today the filter matches words in each row's data-search text (title, summary, topics), not the article body.
options: Client filter over the query index (title, description, topics)
Full-text search service
default_assumption: Client filter over the query index, matching today's behavior.
effective: Client filter over the query index, matching today's behavior.

question: Which CDN fronts the EDS site in production?
context: Cloudflare fronts www today and must keep routing the 7 GitHub Pages project sites under the same host.
options: Cloudflare in front of EDS (BYO CDN) with path routing
Adobe-managed CDN
default_assumption: Cloudflare in front of EDS with path routing (README decision).

answer.answer: Cloudflare keeps fronting www; the 7 GitHub Pages project sites keep working under it.

effective: Cloudflare keeps fronting www; the 7 GitHub Pages project sites keep working under it.

question: Who sets the security headers (CSP, HSTS, permissions policy) on the new stack?
context: The source HTML ships none. EDS supports a header config; Cloudflare can add them at the edge.
options: EDS headers config
Cloudflare transform rules
Leave as today
default_assumption: EDS headers config, so the policy lives with the code.
effective: EDS headers config, so the policy lives with the code.

question: Are the portfolio story media blocks (frame, diagram deck, carousel, ladder, stat chips, flow) authored as adjacent blocks or fragments?
context: EDS blocks do not nest; 8 portfolio stories hold another block in their media column.
options: Adjacent blocks in the same section, showcase reads the next block as its media
Fragments referenced from the showcase media cell
default_assumption: Adjacent blocks in the same section.
effective: Adjacent blocks in the same section.

question: Is the target pixel parity, or consolidation onto a shared design system?
context: The plan runs the replica flow on design system v3: near pixel-perfect, changes only through the inconsistency register.
options: Pixel parity (replica)
Consolidate onto the design system
default_assumption: Pixel parity (replica), with register entries for the off-ladder breakpoints, radii and the portfolio 1200px cap.

answer.answer: Pixel parity through the replica flow; design changes only through inconsistency-register entries.

effective: Pixel parity through the replica flow; design changes only through inconsistency-register entries.

question: How are the bespoke article explainers built on EDS?
context: 27 of 28 articles carry interactive explainers or labs (32 explainer roots on 21 articles, 30 labs on 13), most with their own CSS and script. Their copy is authored prose and tables; their behavior is per article.
options: One explainer block, one variant (CSS + JS file) per explainer, rows authored in DA
A code-only widget per explainer with its copy in the widget HTML
Ship the settled DOM as an embed fragment per article
default_assumption: One explainer block with a variant per explainer, rows authored in DA, so authors keep the copy.
effective: One explainer block with a variant per explainer, rows authored in DA, so authors keep the copy.

question: Are code blocks carried with their pre-highlighted token spans, or authored as plain code and highlighted on the client?
context: 45 code blocks on 18 articles use tk-k, tk-s, tk-n, tk-c spans and line numbers. DA keeps code text but not span classes.
options: Plain code in DA, client highlighter in the code block (pixel check against the spans)
Carry the spans as HTML in the code block cell
default_assumption: Plain code in DA plus a small client highlighter tuned to the four token classes.
effective: Plain code in DA plus a small client highlighter tuned to the four token classes.

question: Are the paragraph-level patterns (facts, watch chapters, byline) blocks or auto-blocked from metadata?
context: p.article-facts on 28 articles, p.watch on 17, the byline on 28; DA authors cannot class a paragraph.
options: facts and chapters blocks, byline from metadata
All three from metadata and auto-blocking
default_assumption: facts and chapters as small blocks, the byline built from page metadata in the article hero.
effective: facts and chapters as small blocks, the byline built from page metadata in the article hero.

question: Is the author box one shared fragment?
context: Identical author box copy on 28 articles.
options: One fragment referenced by every article (or auto-blocked)
Copy per article
default_assumption: One fragment, auto-inserted on article pages.
effective: One fragment, auto-inserted on article pages.

question: Should Cloudflare email obfuscation stay on for www?
context: It rewrites email-like strings on 3 articles (code samples included) into /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection links that 404 without its script.
options: Turn it off for the EDS routes
Keep it
default_assumption: Turn it off so authored text and code render verbatim.
effective: Turn it off so authored text and code render verbatim.
